artworks.title: A qui le tour?
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a man in a contemplative pose surrounded by symbolic elements representing historical events or periods. The drawing shows a figure holding a spear-like implement with an abstract form labeled "1870". The character is wearing a cap and rugged clothing. Around him are objects labeled with different years like "1848," "1830," and "1815". The words "MUSEE DES SOUVERAINS" are displayed above. The drawing is characterized by strong lines and dramatic contrast.

artworks.title: Équilibre Européen
artworks.description: The image depicts a person balancing on a round object with a lit fuse emitting smoke. The person has arms outstretched and a surprised or open expression. The person has short wavy hair and wears a flowing garment. The background is a plain surface with shading.

artworks.title: Le couronnement de son édifice
artworks.description: The image shows a large military-style helmet placed on top of a small castle-like structure with an arched entryway. The helmet has a cracked pattern on its surface and a pointed top. The main colors are black, white, and gray, creating a monochromatic look. The castle-like structure has the words "CAPITULATION DE SEDAN" on its front and the helmet is placed symmetrically over it. The illustration is framed by a simple, thin border.

artworks.title: Monsieur sera très bien ici...
artworks.description: This print shows two men standing indoors near a large open window on the right. The man on the left is facing the window, holding an umbrella behind his back. He is tall, slim, and wears a top hat and a long coat. The man on the right is holding the window open and gesturing towards it with his other hand. His face is turned to the left, towards the other man, and he wears a cap, a jacket, and trousers. Light from the window illuminates the scene, casting shadows on the floor.

artworks.title: Trop étroit pour deux
artworks.description: The image shows two men sitting side by side on a throne. Both figures are presented in a seated position, with only their upper body visible. The man on the left has a distinctive facial profile with exaggerated features including a prominent nose and large, downturned lips. He is wearing a tall, ornate crown and his hair is styled in a manner that suggests volume. His attire consists of a decorated coat with epaulettes, and a sash draped across his chest. The man on the right wears a different style of crown, which is also intricately detailed, and a plain, flowing garment with wide sleeves. His facial features are also exaggerated, with a long drawn-out face and very short hair. The throne beneath them appears to be solid and elevated, with visible steps. The background is simple and features plain horizontal lines, suggesting the floor, with no additional details or patterns. There are indications of shadows that add depth to the scene, enhancing the foreground elements.

artworks.title: Two Men Amid Ruins
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing side by side. One man is pointing towards a structure on the right. Both men are dressed in black top hats, striped pants, and dark coats. The man on the left is holding a rolled-up document. Their faces are shaded with subtle details; one man has a visible beard, while the other has a clean-shaven face almost in profile view. Behind them is scaffolding with two workers at different heights. Large stone blocks or debris are at the base of the scaffolding, suggesting a construction area.

artworks.title: La veuve
artworks.description: Two individuals are seated at a table. The man on the left is casually seated with one leg crossed over the other and his arm resting on the tabletop. He has wavy, short hair and a distinct facial profile. He is dressed in a dark checkered suit with a white shirt. Next to him, a woman is seated, wearing a long, dark dress and a veil covering her hair. Her face is partially obscured by her hands, holding a handkerchief. The background shows a bookshelf filled with books and a bust sculpture on a pedestal. The setting appears to be a study or library.

artworks.title: En Chemin de fer... un voisin agréable (On the Railroad... an agreeable neighbor)
artworks.description: The image shows two people sitting side by side. On the left is a man wearing a top hat, with a drooping mustache and beard, dressed in formal attire. Beside him is a woman with curly hair and a bonnet, wearing a long dress. They are in a train carriage, with a window showing a blurred landscape outside and smoke or steam in the air.

artworks.title: Le Dimanche au Jardin des Plantes
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people standing in a line outdoors. In the foreground, an older man in a long coat and top hat holds a cane. To his left, a woman with curly hair and a bonnet is wrapped in a shawl. To his right, another man with a top hat, sideburns, and a long coat smokes a pipe. A woman next to him has her hair covered and looks towards someone off-camera. Others in the background wear similar attire. Foliage and structures are visible in the background, as well as a cow behind a barrier on the right.

artworks.title: Il y a la guerre... les loyers vont... diminuer...
artworks.description: The image features two men in a black and white illustration. The man on the left has short, dark hair and is wearing a jacket over a vest and a bow tie, with striped pants. The man on the right has short, light-colored hair and is wearing a jacket over a shirt, with striped trousers. Both men are standing in front of a patterned wall on a light-colored floor. There are no visible accessories or objects in the image.

artworks.title: Pourriez-vous me dire...? J'ai la grippe!...
artworks.description: The image shows two men in full-body view, engaged in a conversation or interaction in a room. The man on the left is standing in profile with his body slightly turned, holding a piece of paper with both hands. He has receding hair with sideburns and wears a coat that extends to his thighs, trousers, and knee-length boots or stockings. The man on the right is facing the viewer, standing with his hands in his pockets and his legs slightly apart. He has disheveled hair and a thick beard, with a furrowed brow and eyes that seem directed at the other man. His attire includes a dark, open jacket over a lighter shirt and striped trousers. The setting appears to be indoors, with large panel doors visible in the background and the room shaded in various grey tones.

artworks.title: Qu'on dise encore que la chasse...
artworks.description: In the image, there are two figures struggling intensely with exaggerated features. They are surrounded by dogs and a rabbit. One figure is on top of the other in a physical altercation. The figures have exaggerated expressions. To the left, a dog is pulling at one figure's clothing, while another dog is in the background, and a rabbit is on the ground. A hat is nearby. Minimal landscape with clouds in the background. The drawing is in black and white, giving it a stark intensity. The composition suggests a satirical interpretation, possibly depicting chaos and perils associated with a hunt.

artworks.title: Figure of a Man
artworks.medium: black chalk with traces of gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person from the back with minimal details. The person appears to be standing in an upright position with their head and partial upper body slightly turned. The facial features are indistinct and the hair detail is not visible. The clothing is sketched as a loose-fitting garment or tunic that extends to about mid-thigh. In the scene, there are no visible details of jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain with some abstract lines and shapes, suggesting an unfinished or minimalist artistic style. The overall tone of the image is monochromatic with a rough, sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Rest in the Country (Sancho Panza)
artworks.medium: crayon and brown, blue, and green watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on their side wearing a brown garment, with most of their body visible. The person's head is resting on their hand, and their body is angled slightly with their back not fully visible. The face is obscured by a hat, and the surroundings suggest a simple, abstract landscape with soft colors indicating a natural scene. The background is minimalistic with muted tones that complement the person's attire.

artworks.title: Old Woman Seated
artworks.medium: watercolor and black crayon on laid paper

artworks.title: Bathers
artworks.medium: black chalk on green laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract humanoid figures. The drawing consists of two main sets of figures, one pair of figures at the top and an individual figure at the bottom. The figures are roughly sketched using light lines. The top figures consist of one standing figure and one seated or crouched figure, while the bottom figure appears to be in motion. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures. The simplicity of the lines and lack of detail in the figuration suggest an emphasis on capturing motion or form.

artworks.title: Study of a Man
artworks.medium: black chalk with black crayon and traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a partial view of a person's upper body in a side profile. The individual's face and upper torso are depicted, with exaggerated facial features and deep lines defining their structure. The hair is textured with rough lines, and the clothing lines are loose and flowing. The background is plain and neutral, with no visible jewelry or objects in the scene.

artworks.title: Scene of the Tribunal (The Verdict)
artworks.medium: pen and ink over charcoal, pieced on laid paper and laid down
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene. The drawing shows various sections with line sketches illustrating different parts of the scene. In the middle section, a crucifix is visible on the wall. Several figures are depicted, some in long robes and headwear, while others appear to be observers or participants. One figure in the center seems to be engaging in writing or reading near a desk. In the lower right portion, a figure appears to lean over another. The drawing is simplistic, focusing on capturing the essence and positioning of subjects within a structured environment.

artworks.title: The Smoker
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and charcoal on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two figures, with both only visible from the waist up. The person to the right is seated in a profile view, facing slightly toward the left. This person's facial features are softly sketched without much detail, and they appear to have long hair. They are wearing a loosely drawn garment. The person on the left side of the drawing is depicted in a more detailed style, facing forward. This figure has more pronounced facial features, including a prominent nose and distinctive lines suggesting expression. The figure is wearing a hat and a textured garment. The background of the image is plain, with the drawing set against a blank canvas.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies with Two Large Men on the Ground
artworks.medium: black chalk and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various forms and sketches on a sheet. The artwork consists of quick, rough sketches that form shapes on a lightly marked sheet. There are several forms across the page, with one group of figures clustered towards the bottom left. Above this, there are faint lines suggesting other abstract shapes. In the top right corner, there are the outlines of figures or small groups. Towards the bottom right corner, there's a rough shape resembling a head or skull-like feature. The drawing is minimalistic with loose, free-flowing lines.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with black wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple overlapping sketches of figures in various poses. The drawing is composed of rough, gestural lines forming several figures grouped together in different arrangements across the paper. Each figure appears to be intertwined with others, creating a sense of movement and interaction. The lines are loose and spontaneous, conveying a sketch-like, exploratory nature to the composition. The figures are shown standing, sitting, and leaning, with a sense of gravity and balance. The use of ink wash adds contrast and depth to certain parts, highlighting one of the groups especially in the lower right. The paper has a natural beige tone.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a lightly sketched drawing of a person, with a partial view of the body. The figure is in a posture that suggests leaning forward or embracing something, with the head slightly bowed. The facial features are minimal and abstract, and the hair is depicted simply. Flowing lines around the figure suggest clothing, but no detailed attire is shown. The background is a plain, textured paper surface with pencil marks and the word "Regina" written upside down on the right side. The composition is simplistic and abstract, with no other elements in the surrounding area.

artworks.title: Centaur Carrying Off a Woman
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with wash over crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows swirling and curved lines creating an abstract composition. The lines converge to resemble a pair of figures entwined together, one with an arm extended upward. The background consists of additional abstract shapes and meandering lines.

artworks.title: Don Quixote
artworks.description: The image shows a figure on horseback in a light, sketchy style. The horse is depicted in motion, with extended legs. The rider holds an object that resembles a lance or pole. Soft lines in the background convey a sense of movement and speed.
